purpose: Five-fold/two-seed confirmation plus bounded one-fold mechanism discovery, traditional baselines and small cross-source evidence

exploration.criteria: Mechanistic or practical gain that survives code, convergence, paired errors and cost checks; no permanent percentage threshold

traditional.confirmation: only strongest qualified 1-2 families; reuse same target, roles and feature snapshots

cross_source.scope: small existing AFDB assets; electrostatic accuracy only with qualified physical labels; embedding-only evidence limited to adaptation, representation and cost

data: reuse immutable historical T/vertex-p release and frozen ESMC300 residue cache; no relabeling or production changes
exposure: development fold and reused outer evaluations remain exposed; no independent final test claim
recovery: no automatic relaunch on observation timeout; reconcile PID/startticks and receipts; each lane at most2 engineering repair attempts before reconsidering method
publication: code/configuration/aggregate results only, existing owner authorization; no sample details, sequences, weights, raw labels or full logs
closure: actual completed confirmation, a module research-to-experiment decision, traditional baseline evidence, cross-source measured evidence, final independent reductions and Byte/Git/README records
